name: Raymond Elmer Simons
milestones: Born 17 Oct 1921, Lynden, Whatcom Co, Washington
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
Find a Grave, memorial 75368477 (Elaine Simons Rinehart Upham, Desert Lawn Memorial Park, Kennewick)
Ancestry.com, public member tree "Kulp-Ritchey-Dorsett Family Tree" (tree 4662169)
notes: Brother of Beryl Simons Adams. Known as Elmer. He and his wife Betty adopted two children, Carl Ray and Debra Sue.
Married Wilma K. Hardy on 30 Aug 1947 in Franklin County and Beatrice "Bette" Jones on 10 Nov 1969 at Pasco. Died 26 Apr 1994 at Pasco; buried at Kennewick (Kulp-Ritchey-Dorsett Family Tree).
